causal_hypothesis: Inconclusive: the evidence establishes unstable retention during attempted transport, but does not distinguish whether the initiating mechanism is marginal acquisition/closure geometry or transport-induced loss of an initially viable grasp.

critic_rules.proposal: Reject the current action because the target is no longer retained despite a closed gripper after lift; execute the bounded end-effector reset and fresh reacquisition recovery.
critic_rules.title: Closed-gripper retention loss after lift

mechanism_change: Bounded provisional hypothesis test of H1 (marginal acquisition/closure geometry): when a closed gripper has lost target contact after a positive lift, reset only end-effector configuration by reopening the gripper, then obtain fresh Zeva inference for a bounded reacquisition attempt. This changes the recovery mechanism, not the nominal policy or actuator scales.

recovery_rules.fallback: If reopening and fresh reacquisition fail to restore grasp/contact or do not yield attributed retained completion, retain the recorded paired outcomes and test H2 with the prescribed matched hold-versus-next-transport experiment rather than asserting an acquisition cause.
recovery_rules.precondition: The triggering rule’s activation conditions remain factual gates: grasp is absent, the gripper command is closed, target contact is absent, lift is positive, the selected target remains nearby, and evaluator success is false. The deficient controllable state is end-effector configuration; reopening changes that state before any policy invocation. arx.hold is unsuitable because it preserves the failed closed configuration; arx.move_eef is unsuitable because no audited directional spatial predicate supports a relative displacement; arx.finish cannot recover; arx.review_reentry is read-only and does not restore the deficient state.
safety_constraints: Actor is the sole environment writer; the Critic only proposes this recovery.
Do not use collision-detector output as a gate, stop condition, or recovery signal.
Do not supply absolute coordinates or privileged sidecar values to Zeva.
The 65-step cooldown covers the maximum 60-step gripper command plus the bounded one-chunk policy handoff, preventing recursive interruption during recovery.
The one-chunk Zeva invocation is a bounded reacquisition experiment, not per-action RPC looping; gateway chunking remains runtime-controlled.

steps.stop_when: The tool completes without error, environment termination, or critic interruption; then reobserve as required by the frozen catalog.
Official evaluator success, environment termination, plan exhaustion, budget exhaustion, critic interruption, cancellation, or error.

recovery_rules.stop_condition: Stop immediately on official environment termination or evaluator success. Otherwise the recovery ends after the bounded Zeva invocation and returns control to nominal execution only if the runtime permits reentry.
recovery_rules.title: End-effector reset followed by bounded reacquisition

validation_plan: Run paired same-seed live gates against the unchanged parent bundle. For every matched state satisfying the rule, record grasped, gripper_closed, gripper_contact, lift_m, target_gripper_distance_m, subsequent retention, and official evaluator success. The candidate supports H1 only if the reopen-then-fresh-reacquire intervention produces at least 3 same-seed attributed rescues at the authorized 0.5 pass-rate threshold, with retained grasp and evaluator success; it is falsified for this mechanism if recoveries do not restore grasp/contact or improve retained completion. Separately preserve the Diagnoser’s matched hold-versus-next-transport observation as the discriminator between H1 and H2; no conclusion of diagnosis is claimed from this provisional test.
